reviews.text: Can’t recommend AYP enough! They worked with our rescue who was dealing with a lot of nervousness around other dogs, people, and new situations. Doggy Day School provided much needed training and socialization, and the weekend classes were a great way for my husband and I to learn how to train our puppy better. Everyone we worked with was wonderful and clearly cared so much about our dog!

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a rating. We’re glad you chose Applause Your Paws, Inc. and appreciate your support! If you have any feedback or details you’d like to share about your experience, we’d love to hear from you.

Mokha had a great experience. This is the only place that has taken the time and care to provide Mokha with a dedicated training.  I’ve seen great improvement in a safe and caring environment.  I highly recommend Applause Your Paws.

AYP has truly been the biggest saving grace for us with our Golden Retriever puppy. Romy was not a pup who took easily to the crate and after weeks of trying everything at home, we were completely defeated, exhausted and too anxious to leave the home, even for a quick errand, in fear of what we’d come home to.
We started going attending day school and within a few sessions, we were able to comfortably implement enforced naps and leave the home for brief periods. We’ve officially shifted to her sleeping in her crate at night and she goes in comfortably and easily settles.
Romy absolutely LOVES everyone there (she can’t get through the door fast enough), is learning so quickly during her sessions, and is getting the socialization and stimulation she needs. Will forever personally use and recommend AYP!

We brought our toy poodle Plato for the group obedience 1 class and day-care. Very kind and professional staff. They kept me updated after his training session during day-care and provided guidance on further solidifying the commands practiced in group and daycare (sit, down, stay, recall and touch so far). Plato had a great time and retained quite a bit from 2 sessions (1 group and 1 daycare). Overall great experience so far.

I would highly recommend Dee to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and compassionate dog trainer. Over the years, she has always been incredibly helpful whenever I’ve reached out for advice, insight on certain breeds, or guidance within the industry.

Whether running into her at conferences or having conversations about training, Dee has always been approachable, professional, and willing to share her knowledge. She has taught me several things that have genuinely helped me throughout my career, and I truly appreciate her support and experience.

What stands out most about Dee is not only her skill as a trainer, but also her kindness toward both animals and people. She is someone many in this industry can look up to, and I have a great deal of respect for the work she does.

The moment I spoke with Taryn at AYP, after speaking with several other doggy daycare’s and training, I knew this was the place for my rescue pup Khaleesi. My pup had a traumatic background, rescued her from Big Dog Ranch Rescue, and she needed quite a bit of socialization. I initially thought she needed training but reality is, Taryn walked me through it and said she doesn’t need training. She needs to learn it’s OK to be with other doggies. And she was 100% right! I 1000% recommend AYP.!!! Thank you AYP, i wish I could post 100 videos of how she is today 🫶

Thank you so much for your five-star review, David. We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us and appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. Your support means a lot to our entire team.

Dee and her crew are amazing! She helped me raise my Belgian malinois into the perfect little man he is today! Puppy classes with Alex were a huge help. We even went on to compete in Rally Obedience and placed all thanks to Dee, her passion and incredible skill set. Highly recommend Applause Your Paws to anyone who wants a well behaved pup!
Without a doubt my favorite training and boarding facility. The staff care so much for the dogs and Dee  is always ensuring to do right by them. She trained little Lisa to carry an art brush.

I’ve known Dee for many years through dog rescue work, and she has always been one of the most dedicated animal advocates I’ve met. Long before Applause Your Paws Dog Training became so well known, she was volunteering with rescue dogs and helping dogs become more adoptable through patience, structure, and training. She later started Magic City K9 to expand on her rescue efforts and help address the overpopulation crisis at Miami-Dade Animal Services (MDAS), especially for larger breed and harder-to-place dogs.

Every time I fostered or adopted a new rescue dog, especially larger adult dogs, I enrolled in her obedience classes and dog training programs. The difference it made was incredible. Rescue dogs often come with unknown backgrounds, anxiety, or behavioral issues, and Dee has a calm, knowledgeable approach that really builds confidence for both the dogs and their owners.

Her facility is beautiful, professional, clean, and extremely well run. You can tell how much experience and care goes into everything she does. I’m also incredibly proud of the work she has done with rescue dogs, prison dog training programs, and the continued advocacy she brings to the animal rescue community.

If you’re looking for a dog trainer in Miami for obedience training, puppy classes, rescue dog training, or behavioral work, I highly recommend Applause Your Paws Dog Training. Dee and her team are truly exceptional.

The first time I brought my dogs, Brookie and Pepper, to Applause Your Paws, they were only 5 months old for their first 21-day training program. I was absolutely amazed by the results. They came back calmer, more focused, and knowing all the core commands perfectly.

At 8 months old, we returned to have them trained as service dogs, and once again AYP exceeded every expectation. Training two large dogs together and walking them at the same time requires consistency and precision, and the trainers truly delivered. My dogs came back confident, well-behaved, and clearly understanding their new roles.

Since then, we’ve continued attending their Saturday classes because I truly believe ongoing training is key to keeping both dogs and owners happy and successful. Every trainer we’ve worked with has been knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely caring. This past spring break, we enrolled them again for more advanced training, and I can honestly say I would not have the amazing service dogs I have today without AYP.

What makes AYP stand out even more is how much they truly care about the dogs. They treat them like their own, and my pups are always excited to go back. They also communicate daily with videos and updates, which gave me so much confidence and peace of mind throughout the process.

I especially appreciated that they listened to my request to train both dogs together since that’s how they work with me every day. They really tailor the training to each family’s needs.

I cannot recommend Applause Your Paws enough. Every experience we’ve had with them has been exceptional, and all of the trainers we’ve worked with have been incredible.

Applause your paws is fantastic. I have used their services for 2 dogs for board and train, as well as daycare and train as well as private training services. They use positive reinforcement for training and are the best in the business 💕

AYP is a top notch facility for dog training.
My dog learned so much. The structure and the method of training was exactly what Brie needed for success.

Love going to AYP! The group classes are affordable, the instruction is practical, simple and you see the difference in your pup’s behavior relatively soon. As an owner, I enjoy the camaraderie and the support- my pup Nemo loves the challenge & treats!

We Love AYP. Coco has been going to classes and Day School since she was 4 months old. She started with Private Lessons; then Puppy School and many more classes as she got older.   Coco is now 4 years old and she still attends Daycare/Training at the AYP facilities.  We also participate in group activities all around Miami.
I can’t say enough great things about AYP dog training school and its trainers. From day one, the team was professional, patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring toward both dogs and owners. I signed to trained Coco; turns out they trained me too 😂

I cannot say enough amazing things about Applause Your Paws! I originally enrolled one of my own puppies in their Puppy Kindergarten class, and the experience exceeded all expectations. As a breeder of Mini Australian Labradoodles, I am very particular about who I recommend to my families — and after seeing firsthand how incredible this program is, I now recommend them to all of my puppy families.

Dee, the owner, teaches the Saturday Puppy Kindergarten classes and is truly amazing. She is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely cares about each puppy’s success and development. You can tell this is not “just a business” to her — she truly wants every puppy and owner to succeed.

Not only does she provide so much valuable information during class, but she also stays connected through WhatsApp and is always there to answer questions and support her clients. Having that kind of guidance and communication is priceless, especially for new puppy owners.

This company is absolutely amazing. I would give them 6 stars if I could!

Amazing experience! Their staff is patient, knowledgeable and truly care about both the families and puppies. If you’re looking for a reliable, caring and highly effective puppy trainer I highly recommend this business!
The best there is for dog training! Dee loves her job and you can tell. Her staff are incredible, patient and loving towards the animals!

Dee with Applause Your Paws was absolutely wonderful to work with for our dog, Hank. Hank was a co-owned show dog, so he came with a unique personality and some very specific needs, and Dee handled him with an incredible level of patience, professionalism, and skill.

You can immediately tell she has a true gift for working with dogs. Her communication, knowledge, and understanding were exceptional, and Hank made tremendous progress while training with her. It was clear every step of the way that she genuinely cared about both the dogs and their owners.

If you are looking for a trainer who is experienced, intuitive, compassionate, and truly talented at what she does, I would highly recommend Dee and Applause Your Paws. We are so grateful for everything she did for Hank.

Thank you so much for your wonderful rating, Michelle! We’re delighted to know you had a positive experience and appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. Your support means a lot to us and our team.
My dog was there for three weeks and learned nothing.  A glorified baby sitting service at best.  Do not use tgus service.
Taryn has been great help , gave great advice that will definitely help me !
Manner Maintenance Class is always a blast!! We love  going when we can.

I couldn’t be happier with the experience my dog Oreo and I have had with Applause Your Paws. Since starting day school, I’ve seen such a noticeable improvement in her behavior and overall confidence. It’s clear that the team truly invests time and care into each dog’s development.
One of the things I appreciate most is the daily report cards. They provide great insight into what Oreo worked on each day, along with helpful suggestions on how I can continue reinforcing those skills at home. It really makes me feel involved in her progress.
The staff is incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do. You can tell that all the dogs enjoy being there, which gives me so much peace of mind. Every step of the process has been seamless; from the friendly and prompt support from Taryn when scheduling or answering questions, to Alex A. always greeting Oreo with so much love, and Alex B.  As welll as all of the other wonderful trainers who contribute to her success.
I truly look forward to seeing Oreo’s continued growth and success with Applause Your Paws. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and professional environment for their dog.
Amazing trainers!! We are over the top PLEASED!!!!

We had an amazing experience with AYP, especially with Alex as our trainer. Our dog Loki is very smart and loving, but he definitely had some behavioral issues going in. He’s five months old, and we were honestly worried we might have missed the window or that he wouldn’t respond as well to training. After just two weeks, the difference in him was incredible. He came back more structured, responsive, and overall so much more obedient.

Alex was in constant communication with us, sending daily videos and updates, which made us feel really comfortable while Loki was there. It was clear from the start how much he genuinely cares about the dogs he works with.

What really sets Alex apart is how much knowledge he has and how well he explains it. He doesn’t just tell you what to do, he explains why your dog is reacting a certain way and why one approach works better than another. It helped us understand Loki on a completely different level. His training is clearly tailored to each dog, not a one-size-fits-all approach, and that made a huge difference. He makes it all seem easy, even though we know it takes real skill.

What stood out most is how happy Loki was throughout the entire process. The way he reacted when he saw Alex again said everything. And even more importantly, the training actually carried over once he got home. He didn’t come back acting like he could ignore us. He’s just as responsive and well-behaved at home as he was there, which says a lot about the quality of the training.

We also feel so much more confident moving forward with the tools and guidance we were given, and it’s reassuring to know they’re always available if we need additional support.

Taryn was also incredibly helpful from the beginning. She answered all of my questions, was very responsive, and made the whole process easy, even on short notice.

Overall, every interaction we had was positive. We would absolutely trust them with Loki again and will be recommending them to everyone we know.

I am happy to share my experience with AYP. I was apprehensive to leave my puppy for the boarding with training , but from day one Alex B made me feel confidant that I had made the right choice. Phoebe is a rescue and was very fearful of new environments and other dogs. She gained confidence and has learned so much. Thank you Alex for always sending daily videos and updates.

My 2-year-old German Shepherd completed a three-week board and train at Applause Your Paws, and I’m so happy with the results. He had reactivity issues, especially with people and other dogs on walks, and he came back so much more calm, confident, and desensitized.

A huge thank you to Alex- his trainer, who was incredibly patient, gentle, and caring with him. He helped Rocky through a tough transition with so much understanding, and by the end, Rocky clearly adored him — even rolling over with him and showing so much trust.

Another special thank you to Taryn for all of her help and the attention she gave Rocky, especially when he wasn’t eating. It meant a lot to know he was being watched so closely and cared for so thoughtfully.

I’m so grateful for the kindness, patience, and progress they gave my dog. I would absolutely recommend Applause Your Paws to anyone who thinks they can't leave their dog with anyone while on vacation.

Our dog Ziggy has been going to Applause Your Paws’s day school for almost 6 months and it’s been the best decision for our active and reactive pup. All the trainers are excellent (I love reading the report cards), but I have to shout Alex B. for showing us all of Ziggy’s potential when it comes to obedience training and agility development. We were at a loss when it came to managing Ziggy’s reactivity and AYP has helped us find joy in being Ziggy’s family.

Applause Your Paws is my babies' home away from home! These professionals LOVE dogs and always show it. They are wonderful professionals who understand doggie behavior and training. I've attended level 1 and 2 classes and my babies go to day school twice a week, where they have fun and get training too. They love their school and are so excited to see all of their human and k9 friends every day! Highly recommend!
We have done both private training with Felisha and group training, and I say that she has the secret sauce. Without her my bully mix Lucky wouldn't be so obedient and walk so well on a leash.
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a five-star review. It’s wonderful to know you had a positive experience, and your feedback is truly appreciated by the entire team.
One of the best Dog training classes in Miami the owners know what they’re doing and their team is amazing and very patient with your puppy. 100% recommend.
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your positive experience. It’s wonderful to know that you enjoyed your time with us, and your support truly means a lot to our team.
The team at AYP is terrific!
Thank you so much for your wonderful rating, Brenda. We truly appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a positive experience with us. Your feedback means a lot to our team.

We found Applause Your Paws because our two dogs got into a big fight. We could not even keep them in the same room together after their incident. It was not a quick fix, but because of the diligent efforts of AYP, our dogs are best friends again and play all the time together. They are continuing their training there to focus on their individual needs - one was very reactive to other dogs. She has now gotten to the point where she can give appropriate corrections if a dog won’t leave her alone and can disengage easily from uncomfortable situations. We are so grateful to the team and recommend AYP very highly if you are looking for a place for your pup!

We love AYP! Luna has been going to doggy day school since she was 4 months old! She’s a very high energy dog and has really benefitted from both the training and socialization at AYP. All the trainers are very attentive and patient with her and really tailor her training sessions to her needs. I love reading her reports and seeing videos of her training. And I love that she’s able to have new experiences there. She’s always so happy to get there and never wants to leave. Alex in the play yard is her favorite! Everyone on the team has been great and I’m grateful she has a place to go that she loves. She gets home tired and happy whenever she has school.

I’ve been with Applause Your Paws since my dog Luna was a puppy, and truly can’t say enough good things about them. I started with a few puppy classes and learned so much about how to properly care for, train, and understand my dog. From there, we continued with training, and I’m so happy to see how much she has improved!

Now Luna attends daycare twice a week, and absolutely loves it! The best part is seeing her excitement. She cries with joy when she realizes she’s going to daycare to see her friends.

The sense of community is incredible. The trainers genuinely care about each dog and their well being. I trust them completely and wholeheartedly. Thanks to them Luna is happy and thriving!

I have been a customer of Applause Your Paws for so many years now. The team is absolutely incredible, I am a nervous wreck about anybody watching or handling my two boys and this is the only place I trust! The staff is knowledgeable, super communicative and I know my dogs are in great hands whenever I drop them off at AYP! ❤️

We can't say enough good things about AYP. Our dog Lucy absolutely loves going there, she gets excited the moment she realizes where she's headed. The staff clearly care about the dogs. The environment feels safe and well run, and Lucy always comes home happy and tired in the best way. Highly recommend AYP to any dog parent looking for a daycare they can truly trust.

I recently had the privilege of dropping off my buddy Toño for a 2 week board and train. Toño, a beautiful but sometimes over anxious mini Aussie, came back absolutely awesome.  He doesn’t pull and his anxiety is well more controlled, all while still retaining the amazing qualities that make him my best friend.  I cannot thank the team at AYP for the work they did, especially Alex Barranco, Toño’s trainer, who not only did magnificent work training, but showing my buddy care and attention that kept him happy and smiling, especially the car rides.  Thanks again to Alex for being a good friend to Toño and to the AYP team, keep doing the great work.

I can’t say enough good things about Alex B.! He did an amazing job working with my 9-month-old rescue, Billy, and the transformation has been incredible. At our initial meeting, Billy had issues with dog aggression, and Alex approached the training with patience and clear expertise. I saw immense progress within days. Alex is professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about the dogs. I highly recommend Alex B. to anyone looking for a great dog trainer. 🐾

I have a blue heeler with stubborn behavior.Jonny at applause your paws helped me get mochi undercontrol. Jonny's understanding of dog behavior and problem solving allowed me to take mochi to another level. He went from being reactive to becoming a well behaved dog all around. I would recomend both Jonny and applause your paws to anyone looking to get their dog to another level.

I love the classes and Ty although fearful and anxious likes going there and seeing the dogs.  He will learn.  Dee is amazing, she has the patience of a saint and treats everyone with kindness, going by each pet and pet owner to check progress and give feedback.  It is a truly wonderful class and I plan on going again.
Felisha is very knowledgeable- understanding the body language of your dog and modifying training to you to be successful
Honda is very good boy, adopt him

Lulu lives for Wednesday!!
Every Wednesday she goes to APYP and spends the day playing and also gets some time improving her behavior skills.  All of the staff are always welcoming and Lulu loves them all.  It’s a great way to get your dog acclimated with other people and exposure to other dogs big and small.  Absolutely recommend APYP!!

We just got a new puppy and have been going to the AYP puppy kindergarten class on Saturday mornings. What an incredible experience! All of the staff is super knowledgeable and very friendly. Dee is an exceptional human being. You can tell from the first few moments of meeting her how much she loves dogs and how knowledgeable she is. They even have a WhatsApp chat for questions. We have learned so much in just a few short weeks. I would recommend this place to anyone who is even thinking about getting a puppy. We can’t wait for class next week!

Dee is great and the dogs are always so happy. Train you dog at a place
That does it right.

It’s a delight to work with Kat. She is so down to earth and upbeat.
She always has good suggestions on how I can correct my dog in a positive way.
Jonny is an amazing dog trainer with a very very impressive background. We are lucky to have him.
Trainers are excellent. The variety of dogs and owners is very beneficial for training. I also like that the AKC canine good citizen test is available for more advanced dogs.
This place is fantastic, my dog ​​loves it, all the trainers and staff are kind, dedicated, and love dogs! ❤️

We are currently doing the puppy kindergarten class with Cocoa Chanel our Australian Labradoodle. Dee has been fantastic with tips and tricks to help with the tough puppy stage. Cocoa’s favorite part is playing with the other pups.

I’ve had the pleasure of working with apy for over 10 years for commercials with their clients pets casted. The staff is kind and patient and Dee is an incredible person for running this place so smoothly. Highly recommend
Excellent training classes with a great instructor, our dog loves it!
Had a very productive session with Felisha. She was great. Very knowledgeable and patient with my little Autumn.

Dee and her amazing team have seen my dog Azula literally grow and flourish. To think that I started at AYP at puppy classes, and now we are competing in obedience soon, all thanks to them. It has been a wild journey raising my puppy and I am so thankful to find such knowledgeable resources to competing in sports with my dog which is one of the reasons why I got her. I owe it to AYP. EVERYONE is so kind, passionate, and talented. Will be coming here with all of my dogs and recommending them to anyone who has a dog.

We had a home visit with Felisha and she was very helpful. We have a 6 month old puppy and wanted someone to check out our specific home set up and how we all interacted. She arrived right on time and immediately set out to help us correct some things that were hampering our training. She was very good with our pup and included our young daughter in the training and gave her lots of advice on how to be a good pet owner. She made lots of great suggestions and then followed up with an email with potty training hints and a text with lots of good products she recommended. We’ll definitely have her back when we’re ready to tackle some advanced training

I had my first group class here and it was such a great experience! The instructor was very knowledgeable and took the time to make sure everyone—and every pup—felt comfortable. You can tell they truly care about the dogs and want them to succeed. I’m excited to keep coming back and learning more!
Thank you so much for your wonderful rating, Samantha. We’re thrilled to know you had a positive experience and truly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback.

I’ve been taking my Aussie puppy, Dobro, to Applause Your Paws and we’ve had such a great experience! Dee has been an awesome instructor — she helped Dobro graduate from puppy class to Level 1, and he’s learned so much along the way.

Dobro also goes to day school, and I love how Clay, KT, Alex, and the rest of the trainers take the time to write detailed report cards after each session. It’s clear they really care about every dog and their progress.

Everyone there is super friendly, knowledgeable, and patient — you can tell they love what they do. I’d definitely recommend Applause Your Paws to anyone who wants help training their fur baby!

Had a wonderful time attending puppy kindergarten today for the first time! We learned a lot today and the class was well organized with a great flow—which is really impressive with a bunch of puppies. We are looking forward to our next class!

Absolutely recommended,  to anyone interested in growing, learning and advancing together with dog in so many ways. Nothing like having these folks coaching you and answering questions live and on the go. We came in with our toy poodle at 4 months and it has made an enormous impact in our path to growth. Highly recommended if you have a little one and have been thinking about starting in a safe, cool and fun space. Thank you Mr Dee, you are great!
Dee and the entire staff at AYP are thoughtful, patient and so kind. I have loved working with them and look forward to many more sessions!
Dee and her team are the best!

We’ve had such an awesome experience training our Honey at Applause Your Paws!! 🐾
Everyone here has been so knowledgeable and supportive. And it’s made such a huge difference in our dog’s behavior. Thank you!! …

My boy Duke and I have been struggling to manage his reactivity during on-leash walks. Luckily we found the amazing people at AYP and just after our first private session with Jonny at the facility I could tell they would make a huge positive difference in our training. We left Duke for about a week in their board and train program and Alex and the rest of the team did a wonderful job taking care of Duke. We really do appreciate their effort and all the knowledge they’ve given us to progress Dukes training. Highly recommend AYP, thanks again!

We had originally prepaid for multiple group lessons, but after our first lesson realized the group setting wasn't a good fit for our nervous rescue.  AYP was very accommodating and allowed us to use the remainder of our credit toward a private lesson.  Felicia met us at our local park, and she was so great with our dog!  She quickly grasped our dog's temperament, established trust, and even helped us identify tricks and tools we could use with consideration to our dog's breed and unique characteristics.  Thank you so much Felicia!
The Miami Dade Animal Shelter recommended this business. We made an appointment and I waited over 20 minutes outside of the business and no one showed up or answered any calls or texts.
Amazing trainers! Felisha came to our home and we’ve had our puppy in day camp with KT. Can’t thank Applause your Paws enough!! They’re the best!

I cannot recommend AYP enough! We have two adult 9 1/2 yr old dogs who were not dog-friendly at all, and thanks to our trainer Felisha’s incredible patience and guidance, they now accept—and love—our two new pups every single day. It wasn’t an easy journey, but it was absolutely worth it, and I’m so thankful we made this decision to keep all four of our dogs safe and happy together.

Felisha was amazing during our private lessons, working with the big dogs to accept and interact with the pups. Then, in the group classes, trainers like Maggie and Alex helped the puppies learn obedience skills (and even some fun tricks!). Every trainer we worked with is knowledgeable, kind, and truly invested in our dogs’ success.

This has been the best money I’ve ever invested in our fur family. We are now living in harmony, and I couldn’t be more grateful!

AYP is great! The faculty is clean and spacious, and the team is very organized and synced from the moment they open.  And their one on one training is wonderful as well.  Felisha is amazing with our rough dogs. She speaks and they listen. She is giving us confidence to be more firm with them, and has a great way to feed treats to toothy dogs. I wish we could have her come over every week!

Wow! I just had my first dog training session with Dee and she taught me and my dog Mischa so much. One of the most important things she taught was how I can use recall during play so that my dog will recall in the moment I need her to. I have a concrete plan now to train my dog like Dee would, which is priceless. I am so grateful for what both of us learned today that we can practice together at home!
Thank you so much for your wonderful rating! We truly appreciate your support and are delighted to know you had a positive experience with us. Your feedback means a lot to our team.

I was introduced to Dee by a friend/vet when my old Service Dog passed away and I was looking for a different breed to be trained for the task. Dee welcomed me like an old friend during our zoom meetings to discuss my lifestyle, needs and potential breed. In 4 months I finally welcomed my puppy and started to work with AYP immediately after first vaccine, it was my best decision ever! Bitsy created a bond with Dee that I even get jealous! The team is very nice and always smiling, Bitsy also spent a couple of weeks with Wilfredo and she is crazy for him. We worked on basic obedience with lessons at the school, in my home, on the streets and stores, plus boarding school. I trust them completely when I have to travel abroad and can't take Bitsy with me. They send me  many updates, photos, videos and reports. We are now flying together to train her at the airport, crowds, plane, etc. Thank you AYP for this 2 years journey and for taking such good care of us.

We got a recommendation from the Miami Dade shelter to try a free class with AYP. I got So many questions asked before going. The day before our appointment I got an email with an address for our Saturday appointment and it was the wrong place. I spent the whole morning driving around with my son and puppy. They don’t answer the phone because it’s the weekend. In the afternoon they replied to my morning email and they said I should have considered the address from a text message they sent 2 weeks ago. When a day before I received a confirmation email with another address. VERY messy and “customer service” really bad. This was going to be a free class to then continue training if it was a good option. First impression is so bad, so disorganized, no thank you!
Amazing experience, as a rescue dog owner my dog has really grown with the training and guidance from the Sunday morning group classes. Give this place a serious try they won’t disappoint!

We just picked up our Basel girl from Applause Your Paws on Friday and couldn’t be happier! She still has her spunky pug personality, but she’s so much better at listening now, definitely not something you usually hear about pugs! She can sit, lay down, stay, and is just overall much more well behaved. Clay, our trainer, kept us updated on her progress every day and shared great tips to help reinforce everything she learned. When we mentioned that one of our challenges was her jumping on the table during dinner, Clay said “challenge accepted” and even ate his lunch with her to work on that specific behavior. She loved him so much she didn’t want to leave on Friday! Highly recommend.

I booked Puppy School and it was great. I was scheduled automatically. I booked my next set of classes and they said they would book automatically. I booked these classes thinking they would book automatically because i’m leaving in a few weeks. Now they are telling me they don’t book automatically and want to schedule my classes when I wont be in town. Also i learned the same exact same in level one obedience as in puppy school. SAME THING… save your money… just do one course at the most…. I was told this place has great customer service… don’t agree
We are so happy to have chosen AYP! Lorenzo is the best!!! We have noticed an improvement almost since the begining, he is super professional and he loves our dog, Nia. Thank you!

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your positive experience and for giving us a five-star rating. Your support means a lot to our team, and we're delighted to know you had a great experience with us.

Applause your Paws was recommended to me by a friend for my found dog. I purchased at home training sessions with Felisha and I couldn't be happier. Felisha is truly amazing...a real life dog whisperer! Felisha is very knowledgeable, friendly, and patient (with both dogs and humans). At the beginning of each training session she would ask how Duke is doing and if there is a particular behavior I aimed to correct, which I really appreciated. Felisha even recommended that we have one training session at the dog park since I had yet to take Duke because I didn't know how he'd behave around other dogs. It was very reassuring having Felisha there for his first dog park experience, which he very much enjoyed. I honestly can not thank her enough for how well-behaved Duke has become- even my friends rave about it. Very much looking forward to continuing Duke's training at Applause your Paws and highly recommend them to anyone looking to get their dog trained. My one regret is not knowing about them sooner.

Monika was a great trainer and she made a huge difference with our dog, Winnie. Winnie is a 4 y/o rescue with severe anxiety from a tough life and we had a ton of trouble potty training her and teaching her to walk on a leash. Our expectations were pretty low when we called AYP - we just wanted to get her potty trained and thought anything above that was just wishful thinking. However after just 6 training sessions with Monika, not only is Winnie potty trained, she also walks on a leash, she knows “sit” perfectly, and she has almost mastered “come.” Needless to say our expectations were far exceeded. We did have to do a lot of “homework” with Winnie, but Monika explained everything perfectly and laid it out in a very manageable way. She was full of ideas and suggestions. It was refreshing to work with a true professional, who is also super caring and sweet!
